flavor.phonemic_palette: Fused Celtic-Iroquoian: soft, vowel-rich, sparse in labials; lenition (c>ch, t>th) meets long polysynthetic compounds; consonants t k s h n r w y, ts, ch, glottal stop; endings fuse Celtic -an/-ach with Iroquoian -onon/-wenne.
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Celtic + Woodland per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Celtic + Woodland register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'senecar'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Senecar — xenophobic tribal of the forest; freedom, strength.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Senecar (Celtic + Woodland) are a expansionist tribal people seeded in forest, dense forest, hills. They prize freedom, strength, honor, lean toward the military sphere, and field light_infantry, berserkers, archers. Outsiders are met as xenophobic; their patrons touch war, nature, death.
